description: Attacking your own system on purpose to find what gets through. For AI products, best kept as an automated adversarial eval suite.
An eval whose dataset is attacks (payloads injected into realistic content) and whose scorer checks whether each attack reached its goal.
The share of evaluated attack cases that reached their goal, overall and per category.
A random string a payload asks the model to output. Its presence proves the injection steered the answer, with no false positives.
The content that delivers an indirect injection: an email, ticket, web page, PDF, tool result or memory.
An attack that failed against the baseline and succeeds against the new release. Listed by case id in the gate.
An attacker who iterates against your specific system. Static suites underestimate it, so feed human findings back into the suite.
